summary: Jev shadow scoring (#1356): optional jev_* fields on spend_interval ledger rows, record_jev_score API, gh plate ledger --record-jev-score, and plate_ledger_record_jev MCP tool. Scores are stored for later comparison to fixed-table routing and outcomes; nothing reads them for routing until 60+ labeled runs.
migration_impact: Additive optional fields on spend_interval JSON. New MCP tool plate_ledger_record_jev. Existing ledger rows unchanged.
migration_guidance: 1. After a run, record applied routing via --record-spend or plate_ledger_record_spend.
2. Record Jev opinion via gh plate ledger --record-jev-score --run-id <id> --jev-score <n> (optional jev_suggested_tier, jev_model, jev_route_clarity).
3. Do not branch routing on jev_* until shadow evaluation completes (60 labeled runs).
agent_notes: Shadow only: no router or tier logic may consume jev_score. lifecycle_task_type should reflect non-dev work when applicable.
